dedupe_keys.name: wms mapama gob es flood hazard datasets

description: wms.mapama.gob.es: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Official INSPIRE Data and Services Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wms.mapama.gob.es. Coverage: the area served by wms.mapama.gob.es. The listing groups 14 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Zonas inundables de inundación frecuent; Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Zonas inundables de probabilidad baja o; Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Áreas de Riesgo Potencial Significativo; Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Zonas inundables con alta probabilidad . Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-codsi.
